title: Aspect Protocol Message
description: Framed stdio protocol for cross-language communication between aspect clients and collectors. Transport: stdin/stdout with 4-byte big-endian uint32 length prefix followed by UTF-8 JSON payload. Stderr is reserved for diagnostics.

InvokeMessage.description: Client → Collector request to run an analysis method. The 'method' field selects the operation and 'params' carries method-specific arguments.

protocolVersion.description: Semantic version of the framed stdio protocol. Must be '1.0' for this schema revision.

type.description: Message type discriminator. Always 'invoke' for invocation requests.

requestId.description: Unique identifier that correlates this request with its response messages (progress, chunk, result, error, complete).

method.description: The analysis method to invoke. Known methods: 'collect' (run aspect collection), 'getCapabilities' (query supported aspects and options).

params.description: Method-specific parameters. Shape depends on the 'method' field. For 'collect': includes rootDir, includeAspects, excludeAspects, options. For 'getCapabilities': may be omitted or empty.

rootDir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory to analyse.

includeAspects.description: If provided, only these aspects will be collected. Null or omitted means collect all available aspects.

excludeAspects.description: Aspects to skip during collection. Null or omitted means no exclusions.

options.description: Tool-specific options forwarded to the collector. Shape is defined by each collector implementation.

ProgressMessage.description: Collector → Client status update emitted during collection. Multiple progress messages may be sent per request.

protocolVersion.description: Semantic version of the framed stdio protocol.

type.description: Message type discriminator. Always 'progress' for status updates.

requestId.description: Identifier of the originating invoke request this progress belongs to.

message.description: Human-readable status message describing what the collector is currently doing.

percentage.description: Estimated completion percentage (0–100). Null when the collector cannot estimate progress.

aspect.description: The aspect currently being collected, if applicable. Null when progress is not aspect-specific.

ChunkMessage.description: Collector → Client partial data delivery for streaming large results. Each chunk carries items for a single section of CollectedCodeData.

protocolVersion.description: Semantic version of the framed stdio protocol.

type.description: Message type discriminator. Always 'chunk' for partial data delivery.

requestId.description: Identifier of the originating invoke request this chunk belongs to.

section.description: Which section of CollectedCodeData this chunk belongs to (e.g. 'entities', 'relationships', 'duplicationSignals').

data.description: Array of items for the specified section. Item shape depends on the section type.

index.description: Zero-based chunk index within this section. Chunks for the same section arrive in order.

final.description: True if this is the last chunk for this section. The client can consider the section complete once a chunk with final=true is received.

ResultMessage.description: Collector → Client final complete result for an invocation. For 'collect' the data is CollectedCodeData; for 'getCapabilities' the data is CapabilitiesResult.

protocolVersion.description: Semantic version of the framed stdio protocol.

type.description: Message type discriminator. Always 'result' for final results.

requestId.description: Identifier of the originating invoke request this result answers.

data.description: The complete result payload. Shape depends on the invoked method — CollectedCodeData for 'collect', CapabilitiesResult for 'getCapabilities'.

ErrorMessage.description: Collector → Client error response. Sent when an invocation fails. May be followed by a 'complete' message.

protocolVersion.description: Semantic version of the framed stdio protocol.

type.description: Message type discriminator. Always 'error' for error responses.

requestId.description: Identifier of the originating invoke request that failed.

code.description: Machine-readable error code for programmatic handling.

message.description: Human-readable error description suitable for logging or display.

details.description: Additional structured error context (stack traces, failed aspect names, etc.). Null when no extra context is available.

CompleteMessage.description: Collector → Client terminal message. Exactly one 'complete' is sent per requestId after 'result' or 'error'. Signals that no further messages will arrive for this request.

protocolVersion.description: Semantic version of the framed stdio protocol.

type.description: Message type discriminator. Always 'complete' for terminal acknowledgements.

requestId.description: Identifier of the originating invoke request this completion signals.

success.description: True if the invocation succeeded (a 'result' was sent), false if it failed (an 'error' was sent).

oneOf.description: Execution summary with timing and per-aspect outcome.

aspectsCompleted.description: Names of aspects that completed successfully.

aspectsFailed.description: Names of aspects that failed during collection.

duration.description: Total wall-clock duration of the invocation in milliseconds.

summary.description: Execution summary. Null when summary information is not available (e.g. for non-collect methods).
